title: Press the subscript to read the route station
goal: understands array subscripts starting from 0, and uses length to determine whether the position is valid.
summary: The navigation interface needs to read a certain station name from the station array. When the line has not been entered or the subscript is out of range, use null to indicate that there is no site.
tasks: completes readStop(stops, index). stops is an array of station names, and index is an integer index starting from 0.
returns the corresponding station name when the index is valid. Returns null if the index is negative or greater than or equal to the array length.

example.note: indicates the number of elements. Subscripts start at 0, so the last subscript of the three-term array is 2.

hint: has crossed the end when index is equal to stops.length. Use >= when checking upper bounds, so empty arrays will also return null.
